headline: IDX Highlights Land Dispute Involving Indika (INDY) Subsidiary at Gold Mine
summary: The Indonesia Stock Exchange flagged a land dispute involving PT Masmindo Dwi Area, a subsidiary of Indika Energy. Indika says its Awak Mas gold project continues to run normally.
why: Indika Energy is an Indonesian coal and energy holding company, and the exchange oversees disclosure and listing obligations for its shares.
original_headline: BEI Soroti Sengketa Lahan Anak Usaha Indika (INDY) di Tambang Emas
